column3: With what little power Nostra has left in this reality, there isn't much we can do...
But everyone's placed their faith in me...
And everyone's placed their faith in \PN!
Listen!
JULIA: Everyone knows \PN's the best~
He'll put Team Meteor to final rest~!
She'll put Team Meteor to final rest~!
They'll put Team Meteor to final rest~!
VICTORIA: Everyone is hoping for an ending no one has the power to bring about.
But we can still help, right?
Weak, imperfect and powerless as we may be,
We can still make a difference.
FLORINIA: This speaker--
No, rather... I myself have yet to learn how to truly acknowledge and deal with the spectrum of emotions available to the human mind.
But I accept that they are inextricably there.
This one, at least, can be identified as...
Hope.
AMARIA: All things have to end eventually, don't they?
Perhaps it's only fitting for someone like me,
But if the world burns out, I'll never learn to be happy.
\PN, I trust you to make sure the thing that ends is Team Meteor.
SAPHIRA: This long fight is coming to an end.
Go for the throat.
And if that's not enough, then the heart.
SHELLY: One day I'm going to be the best Bug Type Trainer in the whole wide world!
That's right, this world! The one we've all fought for together!
CAL: Everything has the ability to change.
Let's count on it doing so now.
NOEL: There are too many things I don't understand,
Like love and family and people.
But I'll figure it out.
That probability still exists.
CHARLOTTE: Oh, please, like \PN would get this far and just fall flat now.
The job's already like, 99% done.
Finish it out, wrecking ball!
AYA: If it weren't for \PN, we already wouldn't still be here.
HARDY: But we are here, and nothing's gonna change that!
\PN'll see to it, right?!
SERRA: Even if everything is in pieces now, that doesn't mean that nothing good can come from them.
All that's necessary is the strength to move forward anyway.
LUNA: Forget us not, \PN.
I am yet closer than ever to you.
I, too, will not allow this to end in such a way.
This is not the darkness we should treasure.
TITANIA: Hmph.
You really think \PN's gonna give in to something like that?
I don't think he even knows the meaning of 'quitting'.
I don't think she even knows the meaning of 'quitting'.
I don't think they even know the meaning of 'quitting'.
ADRIENN: Champion!
If you're out there, then make no mistake!
This is your moment to shine!
Take everything the future has for you in hand once and for all!
CIEL: That buffoon's really gone out there somewhere, hasn't he.
Still, I have faith that he and his pig-headed attitude are alive and well.
Don't you go flipping the script on us either just yet!
This show is not over!
ASTER: That group's gotten so far, have they?
At this rate, maybe there's even hope for Eclipse...
BLAKE: Don't tell me that things aren't going well.
How do you expect me to stay on the winning side if you go and lose now?
Not that Cal isn't going to slap me straight off the mountainside regardless if I step out of line...
ARCLIGHT: Yo, here's one for everyone listening out there now!
You may not know it since this news ain't breaking, but it's a personal score too.
As we speak one person is out there fighting to bring order to our world once and for all.
Let's have a big hand out there for \PN!
HEATHER: This whole thing wasn't my dad's fault, right?
He just got wrapped up in it because of the bad guys.
You'd better make sure no one has to go through what my parents did ever again!
LAURA: Everything in nature, as it is in life, is fleeting.
Even the harshest winters must subside before long........
And when they do, a fruitful spring is yet to come.
BENNETT: This is the final stage of the world's metamorphosis, isn't it?
But there's no need to worry.
I know \PN well enough to say for certain that they'll be able to seal the deal!
FERN: Tch, so that loser's still floundering around out there?
Get it together already.
Anyone who beats me like that should have no trouble wiping the floor with someone like her.
You and I both know you got this, so don't even act like you don't!
ELIAS: The Lord has been perverted by this woman for too long.
\PN, righteousness is yours and yours alone to bring down.
ZERO: Someone like me shouldn't have to say this, but the only option left is to win, right?
EVE: This is my final mistake to be erased--
The Arc-PULSE, which Lin managed to complete after all...
Still, between the PULSE Arceus and \PN, I will firmly insist on betting on \PN.
LUMI: You can do it!
All of us-- the whole world-- is counting on you!
This is your time to shine!
ANNA: This is the power of everyone's wish!
ANNA: With the strong bonds that we've all forged since this all began...
We won't let you burn out just yet!
ANNA: Lin's not the only one with the power to change the world...
If Nostra's strength isn't enough, then I'll become the vessel for everyone's hope!
ANNA: Even if it takes so much energy that reality rejects me, too...
ANNA: We'll reshape the world so that Lin can finally be defeated...
ANNA: ...And so that \PN can live on for everyone's victory!
ANNA: This is your moment!
For once and all, do it!
LIN: hahhhhhh???
oh my GOD, are you really going to overcome the impossible with the power of friendship?
how cliche can you GET???
obviously anna would do something stupid like that
didn't i tell you in the first place that FRIENDS DON'T HELP?!
oh, but she can't hear me now, can she?
she's gone, isn't she?
oopsies~
don't look at me like it's my fault though!
she chose to use so much power to bend reality!
imagine that???
having to try????
ahahaha!!??
you know, things like that, altering reality...
they just come naturally to me now!!
when i first found puppy arceus, even his powers weren't fully developed.
but now he can do anything i want!
isn't that right, puppy?
LIN: see????
isn't he beautiful???
i made the doll finish the Arc-PULSE and used abra to teleport it down here WAY before you ever showed up.
a PULSE that makes a baby Pokémon grow to adulthood instantly...
wouldn't that be so boring?????
i didn't make the Arc-PULSE to mature arceus.........
i just wanted him to be... different.
you know why???
because he's mine.
and he's going to be the BEST puppy.
we both know he's better this way anyway.
every pokemon grows up to be just like every other pokemon.
and puppy didn't just end up in the void.
why would he even want to be just like all the rest of them?
besides, what do YOU know about us?!
we didn't ASK to be born into this stupid world!
adults get away with doing shitty things all the time, right?
lovers cheat, doctors lie, parents can do anything they want to a child...
that's how it works, RIGHT???
it's not supposed to be that way, but that's what happens, RIGHT?
so tell me, huh?
why can everyone else out there get away with doing all kinds of nasty things, but THIS is what crosses the line?!
LIN: TELL ME WHY!
WHY AM I THE ONE THAT EVERYONE WANTS TO HURT?!
i've done plenty of bad things now but nobody WAITED for me to do them before hurting ME.
LIN: what, don't you pity me yet????
it's just how the world works.
everyone else deals with it without becoming evil, right?
can't you only say that because of your privilege???
everyone else didn't HAVE this power staring them down.
everyone else HAD things that i didn't.
absolute power blah blah blah
even if you said you wouldn't do the same thing, aren't you just lying to yourself??
cuz you know what??
i'm here for the same reason you are.
because it's fun.
it was a game!
and if it wasn't fun, even you wouldn't still be here, right!?
it wasn't too hard, right??
and why do you think that was????
what, just because you're the chosen one like some kind of main character or some garbage like that?
i mean, sure, maybe anna gave you plot armor or something stupid like that,
but who do you think MADE it so you could win in the first place?
you didn't HAVE to get any critical hits.
and isn't it CONVENIENT that every area you prance through just happens to have a way out?
who do you think put all those light shards around?
they look suspiciously like part of an Arceus, don't they???
huh, i wonder!!
i'm not saying everything you've done has been worthless or whatever.
i'm just saying, a little appreciation would be nice.
we've been playing this game together since the very beginning.
lin was just a puppet...
kind of like the AI in a game.
she didn't talk that much, but she acted when it counted and got things done that no one else could...
doesn't that sound familiar????
you get it, right??
a silent protagonist like you is just a vessel for someone else to play with!
and that someone else...
don't say it's \v[571] or something stupid like that!
obviously it was me the whole time!
huh?
but only a crazy girl would waste time talking to her own toy like this...
oh wait, heeheeheehee...
why trying to fight me is useless???
because if you beat me, then what's gonna happen to you???
no one to play with, uh oh!
guess the game's over, gotta go home!
and no one wants it to be over.
if you really did, you'd just walk away right now.
but you won't!
eyes glazed over, mouth open, "what is she even saying????"
you only want the game to end when someone ELSE is responsible for it, right?
these are just words you decided to sit through, right?
until the next time you actually are prompted to do something for real, right?
fine, if you insist!
if you really want to end the game so badly!
we can still play with arceus a whole lot more!
LIN: really??????
arceus????
don't tell me i messed with you too much...
hey...
wake up?
you're supposed to be a god, right?
you were supposed to make it so we wouldn't be sad anymore, right?
we were supposed to make a world where we could be happy,
where nobody forgot about us, or scared us, or made us do things we didn't want,
you can do that, can't you?
so why are you making our own toy turn against us???
stop it, okay?
that's NOT fun anymore.
if we're going to play this game, then you NEED to listen to me.
we were supposed to be the only ones who understood each other, RIGHT?
otherwise, what was the point of making a world just for ourselves????
so just LISTEN and BEHAVE and it'll be okay, RIGHT?
you're mine, and you always will be.
and i'm yours.
and we take care of each other like people are SUPPOSED to, RIGHT?
we'll always have each other--
forever,
right?
LIN: oh.
so that's how you felt...
then...
you're just like me, after all.
LIN: hahhh?
that's it???
you came all this way just to lose here.
that is truly, remarkably,
STUPID.
ahahhahaha!
after anna's speech and everything, you just go and lose???
wowowowowowowow
but it just goes to show you,
after all the time anna and i both put in to raise you up...
a useless toy like you...
...isn't needed by anyone.
AMARIA: Oh, it's you!
I heard you eloped with Lin, but you decided to come back after all?
That's amazing.
You're here to help out with this now too, right?
Here, look.
These tablets are just covered in braille.
I was originally going to try and deal with this myself since it's right by my house, but...
Trying to translate this much text manually is just useless...
I've been here for a while already and hardly made any progress.
Frankly, I'm about ready to throw in the towel.
I think our best bet is to find someone who's already familiar with braille, but...
The only person I've heard of who was blind was the old guy in the Elite Four, and no one's heard from him since Lin disappeared.
We'll probably have to find someone else, but I have no idea who...
I don't suppose you know anyone else who might be able to translate this, do you?
For now, I think I'll just head back.
Maybe I'll see if there's something else Tania and I can help with.
Bye for now~
AMARIA: Oh, you're back.
Julia told me you had eloped with Tania.
I told her that wasn't a very funny joke.
Here to clean up the mess you left behind?
I guess you haven't really changed at all, have you?
AMARIA: Well, I'll just leave this in your ever-capable hands.
I thought I'd go see what the trouble was, being on my doorstep and all,
But all that seems to be here are these big tablets full of braille.
As for trying to translate all that manually?
No thanks.
You'd probably be better off just finding someone who can read it naturally.
The only blind person I've heard of was the old guy in the Elite Four, and no one's heard from him since Lin disappeared.
You'll probably have to find someone else.
Good luck~
Maybe I'll see you around the Nightclub sometime.
AMARIA: Or maybe not.
DANIELLE: My, what kept you?
I've more or less just about finished going over the whole bit.
Fortunately for you, this does translate to our language after all. Isn't that convenient?
Now, there is the matter of how to go about acting on the information listed here...
You see, that tablet over there describes how in order to open the way forward, an actor must perform a certain ritual.
And this tablet here lists the actions necessary for said ritual.
And while I could simply tell you what's listed here...
Don't you think it's a bit dehumanizing to go about fetching a disabled person just for the sake of serving as a tool of transliteration?
I suppose you wouldn't.
But I, for one, am discontent to play a passive, intermediary role in all this.
So, here's what we're going to do.
I trust you are familiar with the game "Simon Says"?
DANIELLE: You say that, but the last time I translated for someone, they said they knew it and then forgot the entire point of the game.
If I don't specifically say "Simon Says", you don't do the thing, remember.
But if you get that, then you get where I'm going with this.
DANIELLE: Truly? Goodness, some folks are even more sheltered than I'd thought.
Fret not. I shall kindly explain it for you.
In "Simon Says," players are given a list of instructions one at a time by a leader.
If the instruction is preceded by the phrase "Simon says," then each player is to perform it.
If it is not preceded by that phrase, players are expected to ignore it.
If a player fails to do something Simon said, or does do something Simon did not say, then they lose.
Simple enough, isn't it? Even a child could win flawlessly.
So, we will play this game as I read you the instructions for the ritual.
Surely you, a perfectly-sighted person, can't possibly fail something as rudimentary as this, right?
Now, talk to me again when you're ready to begin.
DANIELLE: Care to try again?
Or has this simple set of instructions proven just ever too much for you to handle?
DANIELLE: Shall we get started?
After all, I do so love tormenting people with games-- I mean, playing games with people.
DANIELLE: Lovely.
Now go stand over there, in that middle area. Then we'll begin.
DANIELLE: No need to be nervous or anything.
I'm only here to judge and mock you.
DANIELLE: ...What?
DANIELLE: Messed up, did you?
At least you know it.
From the top, then, when you're ready.
DANIELLE: What, is a little children's game too much for you?
I know I'm not exactly being nice here-- that would be boring.
But if you realllllly want, I can just solve it for you.
DANIELLE: Disappointing.
But it's not as if I won't help.
Stand back then, I'll take care of it in an instant.
DANIELLE: Your commitment to letting me bully you is sincerely appreciated.
But the timing is messed up now, so let's go from the top.
DANIELLE: Oh, so it wasn't all poppycock.
Color me surprised.
Well, I don't expect you to thank me, and I have no intention of congratulating you, so run along now.
DANIELLE: Don't worry; I don't intend to disappear just yet.
After all, I've gotten the impression that this won't be the last time you'll need me.
And I'm sure you would just hate to miss out on our little games.
Kzzzzzztttt--
The Pokémon fled further inward!
Small bumps cover the tablet from side to side in distinct patterns...
DANIELLE: So there were more, after all.
Of course, I already knew that, but I wouldn't want to rob you of your feeling of discovery.
Never say I'm not generous.
Now, step back. I'll read this and tell you when I'm ready.
DANIELLE: Another, right?
What would you do without me?
Now, stand aside and be useless for a moment again while I read this.
DANIELLE: And again.
Any more of these and I should start charging you.
I won't-- but I could.
So you'd better be nice to me, or something.
Anyway, you know the drill. Move.
DANIELLE: All right, I've got it.
Ready when you are.
DANIELLE: Nothing to it but to do it.
Oh, and just a suggestion-- do try not to mess up this time.
Optional, but recommended.
Now, shall we?
DANIELLE: Ready to dance?
DANIELLE: Right.
Start to the left of the center rock. Then we'll go.
DANIELLE: Take your time. I hear art can't be rushed.
DANIELLE: Well, go on now.
DANIELLE: Oh, so you did it after all.
What a shame.
Well, go on now.
DANIELLE: Your ability to follow simple instructions is truly astounding, \PN.
REGIROCK: Rrrrzzzzt!
DANIELLE: All done.
Talk to me when you're ready.
DANIELLE: That cracked ice should reform if we wait a spell.
